entities.summary: Gabriel Ricardo Quadri de la Torre, better known as Gabriel Quadri de la Torre or simply as Gabriel Quadri, is a Mexican politician and former presidential candidate for the New Alliance Party, despite not being affiliated with the party. He was the presidential candidate for his party in the 2012 general election. Between 2021 and 2024, he served in the Chamber of Deputies, representing Mexico City's 23rd federal electoral district (Coyoacán) for the right-wing party in Mexico, the National Action Party (PAN).
